$comment: WHAT DOSE EACH MUSCLE SHOULD GET. REWRITTEN FROM SCRATCH 2026-09-01, and the rewrite is the point.
THE FILE THIS REPLACES HAD SIXTEEN HAND-TUNED BANDS AND NOT ONE OF THEM WAS DERIVED FROM A SOURCE.
They were tuned to whatever the programme happened to contain, and the file said so in its own
prose without anyone noticing what that meant. The glute ceiling was raised from 29 to 42 BECAUSE
THE GATE FLAGGED 36.5. The calf floor was 6 because 'the lowest loaded volume in the live programme
at 6'. The abs floor was cut from 4 to 2 to fit a rebuild. Eleven boundaries were admitted as
unsourced inside the file. A band tuned to the programme cannot judge the programme: it is the
circularity he spotted in the exercise list on 2026-08-27 and it had simply moved to the targets.
HE ASKED FOR FULL BODY, FLAT, on 2026-09-01. So there are no per-muscle bands any more. Every
muscle has the same two numbers, and both are quoted from one source:
Iversen VM, Norum M, Schoenfeld BJ, Fimland MS. No Time to Lift? Designing Time-Efficient
Training Programs for Strength and Hypertrophy. Sports Med. 2021;51(10):2079-2095.
Saved: HealthOS/knowledge/sources/iversen-2021-no-time-to-lift.txt and the full text at
iversen-2021-pmc8449772.xml
VERBATIM: 'Each muscle group should be trained with at least four sets per week, and preferably
more if additional muscle mass is desired and the necessary additional time can be expended
So: floor 4, target 10, for all sixteen muscles. Nothing is invented and nothing is tuned.
THE UNIT CHANGED, AND THAT IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE FIX. This graded FRACTIONAL sets, meaning 1.0
for a prime mover plus 0.5 for every assisting muscle. The 0.5 is an assumption its own source
flags: Pelland 2025 writes that the method 'suffers from the assumption that all indirect training
should be quantified as half a set'. Worse, it let a muscle look trained on nothing but other
lifts' assistance. Erectors read 10.5 fractional sets with ZERO exercises naming them a prime
mover, and nothing in the output distinguished that from a muscle actually being worked.
So the GATE grades DIRECT sets: sets of an exercise where the muscle is a prime mover of a joint
action the exercise actually performs. Fractional is still computed and still shown, because
assistance is real, but it is reported and never gated, and it is labelled as resting on an
assumption rather than a measurement.
WHAT THIS COSTS, stated so nobody mistakes it for a free improvement. Pelland's dose-response curve
is finer than Iversen's floor: it distinguishes 5-10 sets as higher efficiency from 11-18 as
intermediate and 19-29 as lower efficiency, and none of that granularity survives here. Two numbers
that are quoted beat sixteen bands that were tuned, but they are blunter.
unit: DIRECT sets per muscle per week. A set counts when the muscle is a prime mover of a joint action the exercise performs, per the jointAction field on each group in movements.json. Assisting muscles are reported as fractional sets and are never gated.
floorSource: Iversen 2021: 'Each muscle group should be trained with at least four sets per week'
targetSource: Iversen 2021: 'preferably more if additional muscle mass is desired and the necessary additional time can be expended (>=10 sets)'
flatBecause: He ruled full body flat on 2026-09-01: 'lets do full body flat'. Previously the lower body carried bands of 12-42 and everything above the waist 5-10, which encoded an earlier goal he had not agreed to and which made every 'balanced' report meaningless.

all.label: Every muscle, flat
all.basis: One floor and one target for all sixteen, both quoted from Iversen 2021. No per-region bands, no spread caps: a spread cap between two muscles was removed once already for being unsatisfiable, and a flat target makes the comparison the gate rather than a ratio.

erectors.howThisMuscleGotAnOption: IT DID NOT HAVE ONE FOR ABOUT FOUR HOURS ON 2026-09-01, AND THAT IS WORTH KEEPING. Nothing in the catalogue performed spinal extension as its joint action. The one candidate, `back-extension`, listed the erectors as a PRIME MOVER and the rebuilt week was about to be built on it; the attribution carried a jointActionNote saying nobody had confirmed it, and it did not survive. On a 45-degree bench with the spine held flat, the joint action performed is HIP extension and the erectors hold the trunk against a flexion moment without changing length, which is the same role they play in the squat, the row and the Romanian deadlift, where this catalogue calls them SECONDARY. His own logged name for it, "Glute-Biased Back Extension", is the name for exactly that version. The claim was corrected rather than leaned on, the gate went red on this one muscle, and the fix was put to him as a question instead of written into a number: gym-lower-back-1, sent 22:53. HIS ANSWER, SIX MINUTES LATER: "if i need to try a new version of the back extension fine". So the `spinal-extension` group exists now, `lumbar-extension` is prescribed twice a week with no load, and this muscle has 6 direct sets. THE FLOOR WAS NEVER LOWERED AND THE TARGET WAS NEVER DELETED, which were the two easy ways out and are the two this file refuses.

abs.loadableGapAccepted: ACCEPTED 2026-09-01, carried across the targets rewrite. The direct ab work here is bodyweight (dead bug, plank) and progresses by reps, so this muscle cannot be loaded. The alternative is worse: the programme this replaced satisfied gym-catalogue on suitcase-carry, which has ZERO logged sets in its entire life, and cable-pallof, which has two rows in 120 days and his own note reading "feels weird no idea on how form should be". Every other loadable option in the gym has no logged history at all. TAKE THIS OUT the day a loadable ab exercise earns six logged rows.
